results.rationale: Consistency: Excluding the requested background, base, lighting, palette, arrangement, camera angle and title changes, the two chocolate-coated cookies remain recognizable, but their individual coating contours and fine drizzle/crack patterns are visibly redrawn. Instruction: The white setting becomes a brown draped setting with a dark slate base, centered stacked cookies and upper-right lettering. The expected image would also have the exact supplied sentence, velvet and a slightly upward view. The lettering is largely gibberish, the fabric looks coarse rather than velvety, and the view still looks downward onto the slate; the main concept is only partially fulfilled. Quality: Structure and contact shadows are coherent, but the prominent garbled text and unnaturally embossed, heavily textured surfaces are two clear visual flaws.

Consistency: Excluding relocation of the holder and its shadow, the paper has a substantially higher top edge and changed height, the wood grain and contrast change throughout, and the holder contents are rearranged. The coffee cup remains in the upper right. Instruction: The holder disappears from the upper-left location and appears overlapping the lower-right corner of the paper, precisely the requested spatial change. Quality: The overhead composition, rectangular paper, cup and lighting are coherent, with convincing paper and wood textures; a small area of dark pen shapes within the holder blends together unnaturally.
